description: This file defines types and functions for parsing and handling session keys related to agents, threads, and conversation references in a session management system.

methods.name: parseAgentSessionKey
methods.description: Parses agent-scoped session keys in a case-insensitive manner, returning normalized components or null if invalid.

methods.name: isCronRunSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a session key corresponds to a cron run session.

methods.name: isCronSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a session key is a cron session.

methods.name: isSubagentSessionKey
methods.description: Determines if a session key is a subagent session.

methods.name: getSubagentDepth
methods.description: Calculates the depth of subagent nesting in a session key.

methods.name: isAcpSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a session key is an ACP session.

methods.name: parseThreadSessionSuffix
methods.description: Parses a session key to extract base session and thread ID.

methods.name: parseRawSessionConversationRef
methods.description: Parses a session key to extract conversation reference details.

methods.name: resolveThreadParentSessionKey
methods.description: Resolves and returns the parent session key of a thread session.
